title: A Collective owns member Spaces: 5 included, more at the extra-Space price, each with Business tools
detail: PHASE 8 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709). App code over spaces.parent_id (the column exists, no code reads it): attach and detach member Spaces, count against 5 included plus collective_space items, member Spaces resolve to Business depth. canCreateSpace follows the owner default (1 free Space per member; owning Business or Collective lets them start more). Required before Founding Collective sells.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(f)=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const s=r("lib/collective/member-spaces.ts");if(!/parent_id/.test(s)||!/collective_space/.test(s))fail("no member-Spaces module over parent_id and the extra-Space item");console.log("ok: member Spaces work")'
